dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrow pixel radius with a rounded-acute shape classification at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree angular steepness of the anterior margin relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical apex height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, high-radius convex arc forming a rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick pixel width relative to length extending from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical tail fluke with a distinct median notch and tapered tips visible in a lateral-oblique orientation.
